description: This file contains unit tests for the SugarApplication class within the SuiteCRM project. It uses PHPUnit framework to verify various methods of the SugarApplication, including session management, language loading, access control, and error handling.

classes.name: SugarApplicationTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the SugarApplication class methods and behaviors.

methods.name: testACLFilter
methods.description: Tests the ACLFilter method of SugarApplication to ensure it runs without exceptions.

methods.name: testsetupResourceManagement
methods.description: Tests the setupResourceManagement method with valid and invalid inputs.

methods.name: testsetupPrint
methods.description: Verifies setupPrint method executes without exceptions.

methods.name: testpreProcess
methods.description: Tests the preProcess method of SugarApplication.

methods.name: testhandleOfflineClient
methods.description: Verifies handleOfflineClient method executes without exceptions.

methods.name: testhandleAccessControl
methods.description: Checks that handleAccessControl returns null and sets the default hasAccess value.

methods.name: testpreLoadLanguages
methods.description: Tests the static method preLoadLanguages for proper global variables initialization.

methods.name: testloadLanguages
methods.description: Verifies loadLanguages method sets language-related global variables.

methods.name: testcheckDatabaseVersion
methods.description: Test is marked incomplete due to environment dependency; intended to check database version compatibility.

methods.name: testloadDisplaySettings
methods.description: Ensures loadDisplaySettings executes without exceptions.

methods.name: testloadLicense
methods.description: Checks loadLicense executes without exceptions.

methods.name: testloadGlobals
methods.description: Tests loadGlobals method and its effect on global variables.

methods.name: teststartSession
methods.description: Starts a session and verifies no exceptions; marks sessionStartedOk true.

methods.name: testendSession
methods.description: Ends the session if it was started successfully.

methods.name: testappendErrorMessage
methods.description: Tests adding an error message to the session's error messages array.

methods.name: testgetErrorMessages
methods.description: Retrieves error messages array to confirm the method works.

methods.name: testsetCookie
methods.description: Sets a cookie key-value pair and verifies its addition.

methods.name: testcreateLoginVars
methods.description: Verifies creation of login variables.

methods.name: testgetLoginVars
methods.description: Retrieves login variables and checks it's an array.

methods.name: testgetLoginRedirect
methods.description: Verifies that the login redirect URL has a non-zero length string.
